findings.claim: The global CleanUpService ticker in cleanup.go was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute. As a result, all cleanup jobs (snapshots, query history, short URLs, temp users, annotations, etc.) run 10x as often, and the loop can run nearly continuously when a run takes longer than a minute.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:77, the patch changes CleanUpService.Run's ticker from 10 minutes to 1 minute, causing all eight cleanup jobs in clean (pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:88-105) to run 10x as often. Because clean retains a 9-minute timeout (pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:89) and time.Ticker buffers a tick while srv.clean executes (pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:78-85), any run taking longer than a minute immediately triggers the next run back-to-back.

findings.claim: The cleanup log statements include the full ids slice, which can contain thousands of annotation IDs and produce very large log lines.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:534, 554, and 576, the added r.log.Error calls pass the entire ids slice ("ids", ids) on every cleanup batch. Because ids can hold up to r.cfg.AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize entries (e.g., thousands of IDs, tested with 32767 at pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/cleanup_test.go:101), this can emit very large log lines.

findings.claim: The cleanup log statements log 'err' after the error has already been checked and returned, so the logged value is always nil.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:534, pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:554, and pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:576, the r.log.Error calls pass "err", err immediately after checking `if err != nil { return 0, err }` on lines 531-533, 551-553, and 573-575. Because any non-nil error returns early before those log statements are reached, the logged `err` value is always nil.
